entity: Police/fire/veteran/cancer-named 527 political groups spending donations on fundraisers, not candidates
what_we_add: 19 groups, $193.7M total 2014 to mid-2026, $0.36M to contributions, donor-overlap shares with 13 look-alike FEC PACs
why: ProPublica names the same network kind - 527s purporting to back police, veterans, cancer patients and firefighters, money going to fundraisers - same finding, same direction. Its $33M/10-group count is far smaller; our 19-group $194M tally is stated nowhere.
